# CityOps Investigation

Investigate the supplied CityOps incident.

## Step 1 — Read

Read:

- GitHub issue;
- repository instructions;
- relevant source;
- relevant tests;
- previous issue comments.

## Step 2 — Gather Context

Use the CityOps MCP tools when incident
or runbook information is required.

## Step 3 — Determine Current State

Identify:

- current issue state;
- application behavior;
- known historical information.

## Step 4 — Analyze

Determine:

- root cause;
- affected code;
- expected behavior;
- risks.

## Step 5 — Plan

Provide the smallest safe implementation plan.
